def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    ones=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==1]
    r,c=max(ones)
    redrows=sorted({r for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==2})
    # continue down-right until crossing lower red row, then bounce between red rows
    dr=1
    while True:
        nr,nc=r+dr,c+1
        if nc>=w:
            nc=w-1
        if nr<redrows[0] or nr>redrows[1]:
            break
        # reflect before entering actual non-background obstacle (except green, which is crossed)
        if g[nr][nc]==2:
            dr=-dr
            nr=r+dr
            if nr<redrows[0] or nr>redrows[1]: break
        r,c=nr,nc
        g[r][c]=1
        # Stop when reaching the top red row after having bounced
        if r==redrows[0] and dr==-1:
            break
    return g
